title: Travis Taylor arrives as a skeptic

tellings.quote: and a team member. I mean when Dr. Taylor flew out to the ranch with me for the first time, he was an absolute skeptic.

plain: A scientist named Travis Taylor is said to have arrived at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, fully doubting that anything unusual went on there. The ranch's owner, who brought him out and is not named in the record, tells it from his own memory: "when Dr. Taylor flew out to the ranch with me for the first time, he was an absolute skeptic," the point being that a doubter later became part of the team.
